description: Admin (or 'manage' on that integration): set who may use a company integration. Either default_access for ALL members (none | read | write — 'none' makes it role/person-only), or a grant for exactly one of user_id, role (admin|planner|viewer|caller) or tenant_role_id with access_right read | write | manage | none (none removes the grant). Required: provider. Lists the resulting grants.

access_right.description: Access level of the grant; none removes it

default_access.description: Access level for all members; none makes it role/person-only

role.description: Fixed role to grant: admin, planner, viewer or caller

name: set_integration_access
